Record your night

Leave this running by the bed and it works out when you actually fell asleep, whether you stirred, and when you finally woke — then fills the night in for you.

No audio is kept. The microphone is measured, never recorded: every 30 seconds becomes a single loudness number and the sound itself is thrown away in the same instant. Nothing is saved, nothing is sent anywhere, and there is nothing that could be played back.

The read

The Midsleep agent reads the figures above and tells you what they mean. It is handed the measurements and told not to invent any — every number it quotes is one this page computed.

The agent runs on Claude using your own account, so each read spends a little of your usage. One read is kept per morning and shown again free.

Take it offline

The whole app is one HTML file. Save it and it runs from your own machine with no account, no internet and nothing to install.

Install on this device

Your browser can add Midsleep properly — its own icon, its own window, no address bar, and it opens with no connection at all.

The app, as a file

Everything — the energy model, the actogram, the body clock, habits and goals — in a single file of about —. Open it by double-clicking, or put it on a phone home screen from the browser's share menu. It keeps its own diary in whichever browser opens it.

Your diary, as data

Every person, night, habit and goal in one JSON file. Use it to move between this page and an offline copy, or just to keep a backup. Importing adds everyone in the file, replacing any profile it already matches.

Goals

A goal here is a target on something the app already measures, so progress is read from your real nights rather than ticked off by hand.

Estimates from your own entries, not a medical device. The energy curve is a two-process model — homeostatic sleep pressure since waking, sleep inertia, the midafternoon trough and the evening wake-maintenance zone — scaled by your sleep debt. Circadian landmarks use the published offsets: melatonin onset about two hours before habitual sleep onset, temperature minimum about two hours before habitual wake. Chronotype uses the Munich ChronoType Questionnaire's sleep-corrected midsleep on free days. Habit effects are observed differences between your own nights, not proof of cause.
